scored.why: The run explicitly reports that with only three filtered High rows visible, header select-all shows 8 selected, indicating filtered-out tickets were selected.
The run reports that after closing an open selected ticket, its checkbox remains checked, the selection count remains 1, and Close selected stays enabled instead of resetting selection.
The run reports that selecting an already Closed ticket and using Close selected leaves it unchanged but displays “Closed 1 ticket(s),” overstating the number actually closed.

verifications.claim: Selecting the header checkbox while High priority is filtered selects exactly the three visible High tickets, not all eight tickets.
verifications.evidence: After High showed exactly three rows, the header-selection action resulted in all three visible rows checked but the status read "8 selected" (steps 2-3).

verifications.claim: Closing an already Closed ticket leaves it Closed and does not report it as newly closed.
verifications.evidence: Export never finishes was selected while labeled Closed (step 6), and a readable toast appeared after the close action (step 7), but the trace does not record the post-action row state or the toast's closed-ticket count.

verifications.claim: Closing the selected open ticket "Invoice total looks wrong" marks it Closed, clears selection to zero, and disables Close selected.
verifications.evidence: After the bulk-close action, Invoice was Closed but still selected and the status still read "Showing 8 of 8 tickets · 1 selected" (step 10), rather than zero selected.

verifications.claim: Combining High priority, an "invoice" subject search, and Open only leaves only "Invoice total looks wrong" and reports Showing 1 of 8 tickets.
verifications.evidence: The combined filters showed one row, "Invoice total looks wrong" labeled Open and High, with status "Showing 1 of 8 tickets · 0 selected" (steps 13-14).

verifications.claim: A selected open "Cannot reset password" ticket remains Open and selected, with a selection count of one, when Open only is enabled and then disabled.
verifications.evidence: With Open only enabled, Cannot reset password remained checked and Open with "Showing 6 of 8 tickets · 1 selected"; after disabling it, it remained checked and Open with "Showing 8 of 8 tickets · 1 selected" (steps 17-18).

verifications.claim: At a 320px-wide viewport, all queue filters, table values, checkboxes, status, and bulk controls remain reachable and readable without clipping.
verifications.evidence: The harness could not resize the viewport; repeated zoom attempts produced no visible geometry change, so scrolling was only checked at the default-width layout (steps 19-23).
